spacing.notes: Component spacing fixed (20px dominant, 77 uses); section rhythm viewport-fluid: 82px and 128px at 1440w via mb-fluid-* utilities

colors.value: WebGL canvas ~#0A0208 to #8A1F6E magenta ribbons (not CSS)

taste.name: Spectacle at the Doors, Spreadsheet in the Room
taste.trigger: When selling GPU infrastructure that must feel both cutting-edge and dependable on one homepage
taste.decision: Confined the theatrical dark WebGL ribbon scenes to entry (hero) and exit (closing CTA + footer), running the entire evaluative middle on flat white and cool grays — over a full dark-mode developer site, the Vercel/Linear default for infra companies
taste.reason: A visitor decides to feel in the first second and decides to buy over the next five minutes; awe works on a black canvas, but comparing cold-start numbers and case studies works on paper-white
evidence: Hero, mid-globe, and footer screenshots near-black over WebGL

taste.name: The Accent Is a Button, Not a Brand
taste.trigger: When holding a memorable signature color (#FF488B) already saturating the WebGL ribbon scenes
taste.decision: Rationed pink to 0.2% of painted surface — sign-up CTAs, map markers, and the single hero word 'scales' — over amortizing the accent across headings, icons, and link underlines as most branded sites do (restraint)
taste.reason: When a color appears only where clicking has value, users read it as instruction, not decoration; the 10,870px page can be navigated by scanning for pink alone
evidence: Only pink elements in all 5 screenshots are CTAs (SIGN UP, TRY IT NOW, GET STARTED, STATUS PAGE) and the highlighted verb 'scales'

taste.name: Controls Speak Terminal, Prose Speaks Human
taste.trigger: When labeling buttons, nav, badges, and data readouts for an audience that lives in a shell
taste.decision: Hard typographic split: every control and metadata string is 13px uppercase Suisse Intl Mono with -0.325px tracking, while explanations stay 17px sentence-case Suisse Intl — over the conventional single-voice UI where buttons are just bolder body text
taste.reason: Developers parse monospace-uppercase as machine surface and proportional lowercase as documentation; CLI syntax in the chrome ('REGIONS : US-EAST-1') makes the product demo itself inside the marketing page
evidence: 13px is the page's most frequent text size (57 nodes)
Badges: CAPACITY : 2500+, TERMINAL, REGIONS : US-EAST-1, EU-WEST-2

taste.name: Depth Is Paint, Never Shadow
taste.trigger: When stacking cards, terminal windows, a world map, and doc-link panels on light sections
taste.decision: Zero box-shadows page-wide; elevation via a blue-tinted neutral step scale (#FFFFFF to #EEF2F5 to #DBE5ED) and concentric radii (10px parents, 7px children) — over the standard SaaS soft multi-layer drop shadow on every card (restraint + craft)
taste.reason: The WebGL scenes are the page's only light source; competing simulated light would cheapen both. Flat tinted planes make dense technical content read as printed spec-sheet, flattering a product whose pitch is solidity
evidence: All neutrals cool-tinted toward #172B76 ink, no pure gray
